Apply schemeDerived_isIso_of_openRestriction to the resulting pointwise open neighbourhoods. Reflect the ambient isomorphism through the fully faithful inclusion of D_QCoh(X prime).

title: Global right-adjoint base change from ordinary base change
statement: Let Y and Y' be quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], f:X→Y proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation, and g:Y'→Y arbitrary. Put X'=X×_Y Y' [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use the shared quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and their canonical derived base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Let a and a' be right adjoints of the restricted derived direct images, and assume ordinary derived base change for every E. Assume also the affine-case assertion [lem-sc-proper-flat-right-adjoint-affine-basechange] for all proper flat finitely presented morphisms over affine bases, all right adjoints, all ordinary base-change witnesses and all K. Then for every K in D_QCoh(Y), the canonical right-adjoint map [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map] Lg_X* a(K) → a'(Lg* K) is invertible. This lemma supplies restriction and descent only; the affine assertion is an explicit hypothesis.
